findings.title: Collection filters declare an incomplete tab pattern
findings.verificationScope: Source-confirmed semantic and keyboard implementation mismatch; browser reproduction pending primary agent
findings.actual: Four role=tab buttons in role=tablist use aria-selected but no arrow/Home/End handling, roving tab index or associated panels.
findings.expected: A filter button group with aria-pressed, or a complete tab pattern.
reproduce: Focus All pieces and press ArrowRight.
Tab through the filters and inspect their roles and selection states.
findings.recommendedFix: Use a labelled ordinary button group and aria-pressed for collection filtering; leave the lower six editor tabs intact.
findings.risk: Low; UI semantics only; no business logic, database or package dependency.
findings.effort: Under one hour plus focused verification
findings.validation: Keyboard and mouse select all filters; correct counts and selected pressed state; lower product tabs unchanged.

findings.title: Editorial record return is covered by two independent dirty-edit confirmations
findings.verificationScope: Competing capture and link handlers confirmed in source; browser confirmation count pending primary agent
findings.actual: Workspace capture asks to discard dirty edits; accepting leaves the dirty marker set so the record-return link independently asks again.
findings.expected: One deliberate leave decision, with typed edits preserved on cancel.
reproduce: Open a local test Journal record.
Select Return to filtered records and accept the first prompt.
Count prompts; also cancel and verify typed text is retained.
findings.recommendedFix: Let the record-return link own its dirty/saving guard and mark it for the workspace capture handler, preserving protection elsewhere.
findings.risk: Low-to-medium; navigation guard changes require explicit cancel/discard and in-flight-save regression coverage.
findings.effort: One to two hours including focused verification
findings.validation: Exactly one prompt for ordinary return; cancel retains edits; discard returns with filters; history, new-tab and saving-state behavior unchanged.

findings.title: Translation overview has no request or DOM pagination
findings.verificationScope: Implementation property confirmed; current performance impact not measured by this specialist
findings.actual: Fetches complete content entries and mounts all matching document cards while computing review states.
findings.expected: No change required unless measured current scale harms usability; preserve complete review semantics if paginating.
findings.recommendedFix: Measure first; plan a review-summary endpoint or pagination only if current evidence justifies it.
findings.risk: Medium; summary completeness, current source fingerprints and published review state must remain accurate.
findings.effort: Measurement first; implementation estimate depends on result
findings.validation: Transfer bytes, opening latency, node count, filter response, long tasks and complete coverage at current record count.
